title: Repository Structure Analysis
conclusion: Clean scaffold repository with no existing simulation code. Ready for double pendulum implementation.

files_and_directories.README.md: Minimal placeholder file containing only '# pendulum'. No project documentation yet.
files_and_directories..gitignore: Configured to exclude secrets (.env, .key, .pem), Claude/Codex/Archivara working directories, TASK_*.md files, and log files.
files_and_directories..gitattributes: Git LFS configuration for large binary files: .gz, .csv, .npz, .pkl, .parquet, .feather, .dat, .stl, .ply, .hdf5, .tar, .tar.gz, .npy, .h5, .zip, .obj, .pickle. This means CSV and NPZ output files will be tracked via Git LFS.
files_and_directories.research_rubric.json: Research plan with 25 items across 5 phases, created by the orchestrator agent. Defines the full experimental workflow from literature review through documentation.
files_and_directories.TASK_researcher_attempt_1.md: Task specification for the researcher agent (this execution). Contains the full instructions for executing the research rubric.
files_and_directories.sources.bib: Bibliography file (just created). Will hold BibTeX entries for all references.
files_and_directories.figures/: Output directory for publication-quality plots (PNG and PDF). Currently empty.
files_and_directories.results/: Output directory for experimental data (JSON, CSV, NPZ). Currently contains this analysis.
files_and_directories..archivara/logs/: Orchestration system logs (orchestrator.log, researcher_attempt_1.log). Excluded from git.

key_observations: Repository is a clean scaffold with no existing Python simulation code.
Git LFS is configured for large data files (.csv, .npz, .npy, etc.) via .gitattributes.
The figures/ and results/ directories are designated output locations.
The TASK_researcher_attempt_1.md contains the full research execution specification.
No requirements.txt or pyproject.toml exists yet — dependencies need to be defined.
No Python source files exist — all simulation code must be written from scratch.
